Get TPBL Teams

Source: R/tpbl.R
tpbl_teams.Rd

The teams of one season (bracket placeholders flagged).

Endpoint: GET https://api.tpbl.basketball/api/events/{season}/teams

Usage

tpbl_teams(season)

Arguments

season

Required. Season END year (2026 = the 2025-26 season; 2025 is the first). The API keys a season by its own small integer (1, 2, 3 = 2024-25, 2025-26, 2026-27; the event id of /events/{id}/* is the same number): the runtime reads /seasons once and sends that id, so the example URL shows the year. A year the list lacks raises hoopR_no_data.

Value

A hoopR_data tibble: The teams of one season (bracket placeholders flagged). An empty answer raises hoopR_no_data; the columns are always these, in this order (sportsdataverse-py tpbl_teams):

col_nametypedescription
seasonintegerSeason END year (2026 = the 2025-26 season), the year asked for. Null when the body was parsed without the request stamp.
season_idintegerTPBL season id (key space: TPBL seasons on api.tpbl.basketball; 1 = 2024-25, 2 = 2025-26, 3 = 2026-27): the {season_id} of the season game list and, equal to it, the {event_id} of /events/{event_id}/*. Not the GoHoops season id. Null when the body was parsed without the request stamp.
team_idintegerTPBL team id (key space: TPBL teams = franchises, 2-8 so far; stable across seasons): the {team_id} of the division team routes. Not the GoHoops franchise id and not the squad id.
gohoops_team_idintegerGoHoops franchise id (key space: GoHoops franchises, 940-946; stable across seasons; = the TPBL team id + 938).
namecharacterTeam name in Traditional Chinese with the sponsor (Kaohsiung Aquas, Formosa Dreamers, Hsinchu Lioneers, Taoyuan Leopards, New Taipei CTBC DEA, New Taipei Kings, Taipei Mars).
is_real_teamlogicalTrue for a real club; false for a bracket placeholder (67 higher-seed team, 68 lower-seed team in 2025-26).
statuscharacterTeam status. 'ACTIVE' is the only value seen in every sampled route; the full set of statuses is unknown.

Details

Source, terms of use, request pacing, seasons, ids, coverage and error classes of this family: see the notes in tpbl_seasons().

See also

Other TPBL Functions: tpbl_box_player_periods(), tpbl_box_players(), tpbl_box_team_periods(), tpbl_box_teams(), tpbl_divisions(), tpbl_game(), tpbl_games(), tpbl_player_games(), tpbl_player_shots(), tpbl_referees(), tpbl_roster(), tpbl_seasons(), tpbl_standings(), tpbl_standings_against(), tpbl_team_shots()
